candidates.name: The Lipper-Stutsman Co., Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its Toilet Partitions & Accessories page says it will 'custom install toilet partitions for any sized commercial property' in Northwest Louisiana and East Texas, and has the products delivered to the project location.
candidates.reason: Shreveport commercial door, frame, hardware and toilet partition company, in business since 1948. It both supplies and installs partitions for commercial properties. It also sells partitions itself, so it is a buy-around risk. Its site names no partition brands. The contact page shows two different staff email addresses that don't match, so no company email is given here. Toll free number: 800-451-2840.
red_flags: Supplies partitions itself (distributor or competitor), a buy-around risk
Contact page email text and mailto link don't match
